answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the basalt until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the beacon of the next round. By the spiral of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
